newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ to raise airfares by 3.0 pct from Dec 15.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ to raise airfares by 3.0 pct from Dec 15.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday it would raise its domestic and international airfares by 3.0 percent on domestic and international routes, effective December 15.
Air NZ said the increase followed a recommendation from the International Air Transport Association (IATA).
"IATA has recommended the increase because of worldwide rises in aviation fuel prices," Air NZ said.

While a strong New Zealand dollar and price hedging policies had helped soften the impact of fuel price increases, prices paid more recently had been trending upward and were expected to remain high during the northern hemisphere winter.
Another cost taken into account in the domestic fare rise was the recent increase in airport charges.
